input: Research cold-pressed juicing equipment for home use

gold.taskTitle: Research Cold-Pressed Juicing Equipment for Home
gold.taskDescription: Research and evaluate cold-pressed juicing equipment options suitable for personal home use.

questions.title: What is your approximate budget for this juicer?
questions.description: Understand the price range the user is willing to spend, from entry-level to premium models.

questions.title: How often do you plan to juice each week?
questions.description: Determine frequency of use to assess whether a consumer-grade or prosumer machine is more appropriate.

questions.title: Which fruits or vegetables will you juice most?
questions.description: Identify primary produce types since some machines handle leafy greens, hard roots, or citrus better than others.

questions.title: How much counter or storage space do you have available?
questions.description: Understand physical space constraints to filter out machines that are too large or bulky.

questions.title: Is easy cleaning a priority for your decision?
questions.description: Determine whether cleanup time and dishwasher-safe parts are a key factor in choosing a model.

questions.title: Are you comparing cold-press against other juicer types?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user is committed to cold-press only or also wants centrifugal and other types included in the research.

questions.title: What will you do with the research findings at the end?
questions.description: Understand the end goal, such as making a purchase, writing a comparison, or advising someone else, to shape how thorough the research needs to be.
